attack_mechanism: An attacker who forces `openMSP430.decode_noirq` away from its terminal value can keep the selected predicate false on successive `mclk` cycles. This behavior is connected through `openMSP430.decode_noirq -> openMSP430.frontend_0.decode -> openMSP430.frontend_0.exec_jmp -> openMSP430.frontend_0.exec_done`. `openMSP430.decode_noirq` sets the selected completion class, execution state, or transition into the required terminal state; the active mux/state branches are selected by `openMSP430.frontend_0.exec_jmp`. For a jump-completion instruction, `exec_done` is produced by `exec_jmp ? (e_state == E_JUMP)`. Decode and fetch remain blocked waiting for completion, creating a persistent loss of instruction retirement.
